links.comparator_used: Prior system of passive CT perfusion software analysis with radiologist interpretation and notification
links.outcome: Door-to-puncture time at the Comprehensive Stroke Center and interhospital transfer time for thrombectomy
links.effect: Door-to-puncture time decreased 15 min (p = 0.009); transfer time from outside hospitals that implemented Viz.ai was reduced by 37 min (p = 0.04); no significant change in transfer time at outlying hospitals that did not implement Viz.ai
links.quote: Door-to-puncture time decreased 15 min (p = 0.009) after the implementation of Viz.ai at our Comprehensive Stroke Center.
